name: Draply – Dropshipping & Wholesale
author: Draply

sections.description:
Draply is one of solution for merchants in the dropshipping and wholesale industry, offering a suite of features designed to enhance operational efficiency and profitability. By streamlining the supply chain process, our app helps businesses save time, reduce costs, and improve customer satisfaction. And also is a bridge that connects the dots between dropshipping and wholesale operations, making e-commerce management a breeze for merchants looking to take their business to the next level.

Short Key Points:

  • Discover unique suppliers. Dropship from fast & verified local suppliers in the China.
  • Explore over 1 million products. Import thousands of limited and premium dropshipping products.
  • 2-5 Days fast shipping with DHL, FedEx, UPS, DPD, GLS, etc.
  • Automated orders. Stock & price are synced 24/7 between you and our suppliers.
  • Auto-Import Tracking. Tracking numbers are imported to your store automatically.
  • Fast Setup. Create an account, connect your store & import products with 1-click.

Getting Started:

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. In the main menu, click on ‘Draply’.
  3. Click on “Connect this Store to Draply”.
  4. You will be redirected to app.Draply.com where you will have to log in and follow the instructions.

sections.faq:
How to create an Draply account?

Go to draply.com and Simply fill out the form and sign up with your email address and full name.

Then, choose a password and click that you agree with our terms and conditions too.

Before finishing, be sure to click on the I’m not a robot box. And that’s all, you now have an Draply account.

What is Draply and how does it work?

Draply is the ultimate and most advanced dropshipping automation platform you can use to grow your online business!

We’re giving you one platform for everything – manage your team, handle orders, and, most importantly, find high-quality, scalable products from trusted and top-rated suppliers.

More than that, Draply is a dropshipping platform where retailers can work only with the suppliers closest to their customers;

How to set up your Draply Account?

Setting up your Draply Account and starting to sell takes only 5 minutes! It’s that easy!

Step 1. Create an account. You only need your email to create an account. No credit card is required, and no setup fees are involved.

Step 2. Connect your store. Simply connect your store using our built-in integrations. There never was an easier way to start dropshipping.

Step 3. Configure your store and shipping information. This is where you specify your store’s shipping settings.

Step 4. Set up your profit margin. Set up the Default Price Formula for your store.

Step 5. Configure your payment details. You need to set up your Draply Wallet to deliver your first order.

Step 6. Import products. Add products to your store automatically in bulk or one by one. Start selling right away with automated orders.

What is the order process?

Step 1. An order is placed by your customer. We automatically import orders from your store straight into our platform almost instantly.

Step 2. That order is sent to the supplier, who then processes and ships it as soon as possible.

Step 3. A tracking number is updated. We automatically import the tracking number(s) to your store.

Step 4. The order is usually delivered only a few days after it’s shipped by the supplier.

What payment methods do you accept?

We work with the most popular payment methods in the world.
You can pay your orders via Bank transfer, Wise and Credit Card.

How will you bill me for my orders?

We’ve built an innovative wallet system to help you pay your orders automatically with no manual interaction. Enable your auto-funding setting inside your Draply wallet, choose your favorite payment method, and we will fund your balance automatically every time you reach a pre-defined threshold. You can also set multiple backup payment methods, so you are always safe.

Is my store data really secure?

Draply is designed with multiple layers of protection, covering data transfer, encryption, network configuration, and application-level controls, all distributed across a scalable, secure infrastructure.
